priorYear: same fiscal quarter one year earlier only
currencyStorage: dollars as exact decimals; AI outputs declare units; convert in packages/calc/units.ts

agentModels._note: Prototype: mock client by default. A real model may be called only with synthetic data, using an API key approved for this work. Production model chosen and approved at merge.

platformStack: Option B: custom Azure app + PostgreSQL or Azure SQL (docs/13).
_units: All percentages in this file are decimals (0.10 = 10%).

reporting.staleValuationFootnote: Carried at the latest Locked valuation of {lockedPeriodEnd}; no Locked mark for {periodEnd}.
reporting.noValuationFootnote: No Locked valuation on record; NAV is not calculable this quarter.

intake._note: Intake rules (docs/04 M2, packages/validation). Percentages are decimals. figureScale and figureIntegerDigits match the record's numeric(20,2) figure columns; minPeriodYear is the first year a period end may carry. weeklyVarianceThresholdPct is the move against the prior that flags a weekly value; weeklyStaleDays is how many days before the as-of date a report date may be before it is stale; lookthroughNavTolerancePct and lookthroughCostToleranceUsd are the differences a reconcile lets pass; maxWorkbookBase64Chars caps an uploaded ops-drop workbook; workbookMaxCells, workbookMaxSheets and workbookMaxPartBytes are the read limits the workbook parser works to (cells on one sheet and across the workbook, sheets listed, the declared size of one part), the rest stay at the parser defaults.

documents._note: Document hub (docs/04 M3, decision 0012). expectedDueDaysAfterQuarterEnd is when a quarter's report is due; lateAfterDays and missingAfterDays count from the due date and give the expected-document status (expected, received, late, missing), derived when read and never stored; searchPageSize is the hub's page; maxPdfBytes and maxPages are the limits the PDF reader works to on an indexed item.

extraction._note: AI extraction (docs/04 M4, docs/18 section 7, decision 0012). batchConcurrency is how many runs a batch drives at once; runTokenBudget and dayTokenBudget stop a run or the day's runs past their budget (SEC-8.9); quoteMaxChars caps a citation; a value whose confidence is below confidenceFlagBelow (a decimal fraction) is flagged for review, never invalid; schemaRetries and transientRetries are the retry budget per error kind; costPerThousandTokensUsd holds decimal strings, never floats.
